Definition: Gether, a son of Aram, and the region settled by him
BiblicalUsage: Gether is a son of Aram, and the region settled by him, named 2 times in Scripture, in Genesis and 1 Chronicles. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Gether seriously as a real place in God’s story, not a made-up one. That is why its name belongs in this study, even when the Bible says little about it.
